title: Milestones form from mixed-source episodes
setup: sp_goa_dec holds 5 episodes: flights chat (wa), flight-search browsing (browser), villa chat (wa), villa browsing (browser), packing chat (wa).
expected: milestones ≈ Flights {flights chat + flight browsing}, Stay {villa chat + villa browsing}, Packing {packing chat} — each milestone's "episodes" naming the episodes that stage received. Cross-stream grouping happens HERE, with all evidence present.

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §1.1 (carried) CHP-01 · Chapters form from mixed-source episodes — re-authored at the S6 gate onto the V6 vocabulary: decide.v9 (P-05) emits "milestones" ({label,state,episodes}, "STAGES of the goal") and has no "chapters" key at all, so the V2 wording asserted a field the shipped prompt cannot produce. The assertion is unchanged: cross-stream stages, not one per stream and not one per episode.
